title: Kheer with Sweet Potato Crunch
description: A warm and comforting Indian dessert made with sweet potatoes and kheer, perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: 2. Toss the diced sweet potatoes with 1 tsp of ghee and roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
3. In a large saucepan, combine the kheer, milk, sugar, cinnamon powder, nutmeg powder, and cardamom powder. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved.
4. Add the roasted sweet potatoes to the saucepan and stir to combine.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
6. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
7. Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon powder if desired.
